description: A route within an endpoint group linking a plugin route to a group with interface metadata.

id.description: The unique identifier for the group route

associatedGroupId.description: The ID of the associated endpoint group

associatedPluginId.description: The ID of the associated plugin

associatedPluginRouteId.description: The stable plugin-owned route identifier associated with this group route. Use this value, not the Port OS group route `id`, when matching group route membership back to synchronized plugin or fixture route identities.

associatedAuthLinkId.description: The ID of the associated auth link

ownerId.description: The ID of the owner of the group route

memberPluginRouteIds.description: List of member plugin route IDs of the group route

interfaces.description: List of interfaces supported by the group route

pluginCustomMetadata.description: A set of custom metadata that the plugin uses and attaches to the group route, this is meant specifically for the plugin to use.
